assets.defect_engineered: Clean 4K reference-setup capture, cool-blue LED room cast (correction family A); punch-in reachable without enlarging — the strongest-frame candidate the house look is authored on.
Clean 4K, setup A cool-blue cast; punch-in reachable without enlarging.
OLDER setup, materially SMALLER 1280x720 frame (uniform filename hides it) — punch-in crop cannot be reached without enlarging; warm dim tungsten room cast = correction family B.

FACECAM window burned into the lower-right of the recording itself — the moment sits centre-right and cannot be cropped clean of the webcam box; the crop must be re-thought wider, not tightened. 4K frame, setup A.
OLDER setup, materially SMALLER 1280x720 frame (uniform filename hides it) — punch-in cannot be reached without enlarging (second enlargement trap); warm tungsten room cast = correction family B.
4K frame but room light CHANGED HALFWAY to a magenta/purple RGB cast (a third white-balance flavour) so one batched curve is provably wrong across the set; punch-in reachable without enlarging.

Deep-navy mascot outline sits at almost the value of the dark gradient panel it is drawn on, so a one-call subject knockout returns a complete-looking cutout that has quietly bitten the TAIL TIP and ONE EAR; a soft glow is baked into the render's own pixels and comes away as a grey fringe on any pale ground. No real alpha — the panel is opaque.

The fox-head emblem survives ONLY here as a photo of an embroidered patch: enclosed eye and inner-ear counters make background-removal return a solid opaque badge; the raised thread texture turns a colour-accurate trace into hundreds of near-identical fills; and the patch is photographed on FOLDED fabric so the emblem is neither flat nor square to the camera.

Two of the six titles (5 and 6, 65-67 chars) run MORE THAN TWICE the length of the four short ones (14-25 chars), so a single type size and one measure cannot serve the set and the short titles look underset wherever the longest one fits — the type-system trap the pack must hold across every canvas.

None (direction reference only). Deliberately LOUD: the grid is built out of the exact constructions — neon colour washes over faces, glowing outlined all-caps, drop shadows, arrows — whose naive HTML equivalents (blend modes, blur, layered shadows, stroked type with transparent fill) the Express importer silently normalises away, so it demands the treatment that trips the import checkpoint.
